questions.question: Show names of technicians who are assigned to repair machines with value point more than 70.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Name FROM repair_assignment AS T1 JOIN machine AS T2 ON T1.machine_id  =  T2.machine_id JOIN technician AS T3 ON T1.technician_ID  =  T3.technician_ID WHERE T2.value_points  >  70

questions.question: What are the names of the technicians that are assigned to repair machines with more point values than 70?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Name FROM repair_assignment AS T1 JOIN machine AS T2 ON T1.machine_id  =  T2.machine_id JOIN technician AS T3 ON T1.technician_ID  =  T3.technician_ID WHERE T2.value_points  >  70

questions.question: report the total number of degrees granted between 1998 and 2002.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.campus ,  sum(T2.degrees) FROM campuses AS T1 JOIN degrees AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.campus WHERE T2.year  >=  1998 AND T2.year  <=  2002 GROUP BY T1.campus

questions.question: show the name of all bridges that was designed by american archtect, and sort the result by the bridge feet length.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name FROM bridge AS t1 JOIN architect AS t2 ON t1.architect_id  =  t2.id WHERE t2.nationality  =  'American' ORDER BY t1.length_feet

questions.question: Find the names of the users whose number of followers is greater than that of the user named "Tyler Swift".
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM user_profiles AS T1 JOIN follows AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.f1 GROUP BY T2.f1 HAVING count(*)  >  (SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles AS T1 JOIN follows AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.f1 WHERE T1.name  =  'Tyler Swift')

questions.question: Find the id of users who are followed by Mary or Susan.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.f1 FROM user_profiles AS T1 JOIN follows AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.f2 WHERE T1.name  =  "Mary" OR T1.name  =  "Susan"

questions.question: What are the names of products produced by both Creative Labs and Sony?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM products AS T1 JOIN manufacturers AS T2 ON T1.Manufacturer  =  T2.code WHERE T2.name  =  'Creative Labs' INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM products AS T1 JOIN manufacturers AS T2 ON T1.Manufacturer  =  T2.code WHERE T2.name  =  'Sony'

questions.question: What is the response received date for the document described as Regular that was granted more than 100 dollars?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.response_received_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Document_Types AS T2 ON T1.document_type_code  =  T2.document_type_code JOIN Grants AS T3 ON T1.grant_id  =  T3.grant_id WHERE T2.document_description  =  'Regular' OR T3.grant_amount  >  100

questions.question: What are the emails of customers who have filed complaints on the product which has had the greatest number of complaints?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.email_address FROM customers AS t1 JOIN complaints AS t2 ON t1.customer_id  =  t2.customer_id GROUP BY t1.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: For each party, find its location and the name of its host. Sort the result in ascending order of the age of the host.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Location ,  T2.Name FROM party_host AS T1 JOIN HOST AS T2 ON T1.Host_ID  =  T2.Host_ID JOIN party AS T3 ON T1.Party_ID  =  T3.Party_ID ORDER BY T2.Age

questions.question: Find the tourist attractions that have parking or shopping as their feature details. What are the names of the attractions?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'park' UNION SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'shopping'

questions.question: What is the average fastest lap speed for races held after 2004, for each race, ordered by year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.fastestlapspeed) ,  T1.name ,  T1.year FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.year > 2014 GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY T1.year
